Maya R.: Hoping to sync quickly on AcmeCorp commit sizing. They gave peak qps and an 80/20 text/chat split. Need reserved GPU recommendation + autoscale knobs.
Dan - Presales: TL;DR from procurement: 2.5M tokens/day baseline, spikes to ~1.2k concurrent users at 99th percentile. Budget wants minimal reserved to start.
Liam O'Connor: Ok. First question: are chat requests much longer (tokens) than text generation? That changes batch profiles and KV warmup.
Maya R.: Yes — chat avg 250 tokens, text avg 40. Chat is stateful (KV cache per session). Text is stateless single-shot.
Julie (Solutions): My gut: reserve capacity for steady-state text throughput, rely on burst credits/spot for chat spikes, but need KV warmup plan to avoid tail latencies.
Ava Eng: Can we quantify steady-state? If 2.5M tokens/day => ~29 tokens/sec average, but distribution is bursty. They reported 20 qps steady with occasional 600 qps bursts.
Dan - Presales: They want 99.9% requests under 400ms for text and 1s for chat.
Liam O'Connor: For those SLOs, pick a base cluster sized to handle 600 qps stateless + minimal chat concurrency. Proposed: 4x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs (quantized model) to hit baseline latency headroom.
Julie (Solutions): Sound reasonable. Add autoscale policy: scale out by +2 GPUs when 5m sustained 70% GPU utilization, and allow burst credits up to 50% of reserved for 30m windows.
Maya R.: Ops question: what about eviction/spot fallback for their private subnet? They cannot accept data leaving region.
Ava Eng: For Private/VPC we won't use spot eviction for reserved pool. We can use spot for non-sensitive burst nodes in another AZ only if they approve cross-AZ data path.
Dan - Presales: Pricing ask: how will burst credits billing show on invoices? They need predictable monthly run-rate for finance.
Julie (Solutions): Billing model: reserved monthly commit covers baseline, burst credits billed per-GPU-hour at reduced rate; we can provide a cap and usage alerts. We'll include a 15% buffer in quotes.
Maya R.: Security questionnaire: they asked about KMS integration and audit logs for inference payloads. Any blocker for Private deployment?
Ava Eng: KMS + HSM support available, and audit logs retained per contract. Need their SOC contact for specific retention and attestation. No technical blocker.
Liam O'Connor: Operational runbook snippet to propose (paste):

```
# preheat script (pseudo)
preheat_sessions=200
for s in range(preheat_sessions):
  warmup("/chat", session_id=s, prompt=prefix_tokens)
# KV cache prewarmed across reserved GPUs
```

This keeps tail latency within SLO during ramp.
Dan - Presales: They also asked about model fallback: good to include an economy variant if primary overloaded.
Julie (Solutions): We can configure automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model and stream a 503->fallback header so app can record quality telemetry.
Maya R.: Action items:
- Julie: produce sizing quote with 4 reserved GPUs + burst credits cap and 15% buffer (ETA EOD)
- Ava: draft security answers for the questionnaire + KMS attestation (ETA tomorrow)
- Liam: include preheat runbook + autoscale policy JSON (ETA EOD)
- Dan: confirm finance wants monthly cap or commit tiering and share back

Liam O'Connor: quick autoscale JSON (one-liner): `{"scale_policy":"add:2","trigger":"gpu_util>70%:5m","burst_limit":"50%:30m"}`
Maya R.: Perfect. I'll loop in acct exec and legal after we have the quote. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
